failures.detail: The 60 s RPC reply timer fires before the worker's event loop can read the reply when a file runs more than 60 s of synchronous tests back to back. Slower or busier machines cross that line. ADR-0010's setup file yields between tests, which covers a long file of short tests; one test that runs synchronously for more than 60 s still trips the timer, as the 68 s long-game test did on the 4-core container.
